Lena (Sales): Heads-up — Stratalytix closed a 6-month pilot (5 seats). They want private deployment in AWS us-east-1, SSO via Okta, and a 99.5% uptime SLO. Go-live target is 2025-02-10.
Priya (CS): Awesome, congrats! Adding CS runbook owners. Billing / procurement contact? Any constraints on maintenance windows?
Lena (Sales): Billing contact is nora@stratalytix.io. They prefer maintenance between 00:00-04:00 EST. Shared contract link: https://redwood.app/contr/strata-101
Asha (Solutions): Need their Okta metadata and redirect URIs. Also confirm whether they need model updates enabled during pilot (we should scope automatic updates off by default).
Jon (Eng): I'll own infra readiness + smoke tests. Please open triage ticket with expected qps, average token length, and sample payloads.
Priya (CS): Created ticket INF-2407 and added owners. handoff-bot: "Ticket INF-2407 created by Priya (CS) 03Onboarding: Stratalytix 03Owners: Priya, Jon, Asha"
handoff-bot: "Linked contract: https://redwood.app/contr/strata-101 (read-only)"
Lena (Sales): They asked for a soft limit on tokens per user (50k/mo) and an alert if cost > $1.2k in 7d. Also request for audit logs forwarded to their SIEM.
Priya (CS): Noted. CS action items: 1) Kickoff call w/ customer + infra on Mon 2) Capture prompt library + acceptance prompts 3) Share early health dashboard at week 2.
Asha (Solutions): Quick sample redirect/metadata I requested from them:
```
issuer: https://dev-xyz.okta.com
client_id: 0oa1abcDEFxyz
redirect_uris:
  - https://app.stratalytix.io/_auth/okta/callback
```
Lena (Sales): They sent a test Okta tenant and basic metadata this morning. I'll paste in INF-2407.
Jon (Eng): For dedicated/private deploy: recommend start with 1 g4dn.12xlarge-equivalent for pilot. Plan smoke test: `wrk -t8 -c50 -d60s` hitting /v1/chat with 120 token avg. If they scale, we'll plan 2 instances.
Priya (CS): Renewal note: pilot auto-converts to annual if usage > 50k tokens/mo in month 5. Flagging as renewal-risk metric to track.
Asha (Solutions): Also capture their expected sequence lengths and model family. We should lock quantization/precision settings before pilot.
Jon (Eng): I'll post a short runbook in the ticket and a checklist for eng: environment vars, certs, smoke test command, rollback steps.
Priya (CS): Weekly sync cadence proposed: Tue 10am PT until cutover. Adding calendar invite and INF-2407 link.
Lena (Sales): :thumbsup: I'll follow up if procurement needs extra docs.
Jon (Eng): Quick ask to customer (in INF-2407): provide two sample payloads (happy path, edge case) and expected concurrent users.
Priya (CS): Closing loop 12 - please update INF-2407 with artifacts and ping if blocked before EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:
